paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: The chart displays the distribution of error rates for various slots in a dialogue state tracking system, with 15 slices representing different slots. The slices are labeled as follows: passengers (1.10%, light gray), beds (1.30%, dark gray), type (2.00%, gray), range (2.20%, dark brown), class (2.40%, brown), city (2.60%, olive green), destination (3.00%, green), location (3.80%, light blue), intent (3.80%, blue), time (4.10%, pale green), size (4.20%, brown), name (5.20%, dark blue), genre (13.50%, dark green), to (14.50%, yellow), from (17.00%, light blue), and date (19.30%, green). The chart does not include a legend, but the colors used for each slice are distinguishable. The slices are arranged in a circular pattern, with no apparent ordering. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, providing a clear visual representation of the relative proportions.
